_doc: The Boot facts packs read (docs/c1f-stdlib.md). wired=true: `cliffvm` (cli.rs, host.rs, launcher.c1f or scripts/seat) writes it; wired=false: a pack reads it and it is told only when a launch line names it (`--fact name=value`), else the pack's own default stands.

peer_writes.why: the policy of the writes a local peer (over shared memory) asks the seat to make: a list of rules {peer, prefix}; the peer whose namespace is `peer` may write the nodes whose id starts with `prefix`; none by default, so every forwarded write is refused (packs/link.c1f `LinkWrite.verdict`; docs/graph-link.md section 18)

link_hold_s.why: seconds the seat holds an empty poll of POST /ui/link before it answers it empty (the keepalive); default 25 (graph link decision 18; a value tried, not decided)

link_lease_s.why: seconds of silence after which a visible page is gone: its link row is collected and its `Vm` reads `stale` (packs/link.c1f, packs/link_route.c1f); default 60

link_lease_hidden_s.why: the same lease for a page that told the seat it is hidden; default 600

link_window.why: how many frames of the seat a page may leave unacked before it gets a resync snapshot instead of deltas; default 8

link_max_subs.why: most subscriptions (an entity and one property each) one page link may hold; the rest are refused, not queued; default 200

link_max_links.why: most page links a seat serves at once; the next is refused; default 16

link_max_value.why: most characters of one subscribed value; a bigger one is refused with its size and never sent; default 65536

link_max_frame.why: most characters of a frame a page posts (a bigger one is a 413) and of a reply the seat sends (a bigger set goes out in parts); default 262144

lk_since.why: not a launch fact: the time the link pack wrote at start, the seat's epoch of this run (packs/link.c1f)

anthropic_key_set.why: told by `cliffvm`: whether the seat's environment holds a non-empty ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (only the yes or no, never the key); the claude turn is refused without it unless chat_auth is login

chat_auth.why: how the claude turn authenticates and what options.background.chat_auth shows (--fact chat_auth=...): api_key (the DEFAULT: the key of the seat's ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) or login (the claude CLI's own login, an explicit opt-in; it was the released constant)

agent_writes.why: whether the model may write memory (--no-agent-writes)

nerve_pause_off.why: MEMBRANE_NERVE_PAUSE=0: the kill switch for the pause route

ledger.why: the operator's ledger file path (the decisions pack writes it)

door_port.why: the port the Rust door listens on (`--port`; 0 = any free port; the default 4096 is `launcher.c1f`'s `Boot.default_port`)

door_secret_file.why: the JWT secret file the door verifies tokens with

app_dirs.why: told by `cliffvm`: the folders of the apps given to it, the upper layer first; the door serves an app's `ui/` files, an upper layer's file shadowing a lower one's (docs/c1f-layers.md)

ui_dir.why: an extra folder of the page's files: the lowest layer under each app's own ui/ folder (`cliffvm run --ui-dir`; none by default and none in `serve`)

seat_named.why: whether the person named the seat

seat_stt.why: the speech-to-text server url, else the browser listens

seat_backend.why: the model backend's url (ollama), for the model list

seat_default.why: developer mode: `--fact seat_default=claude` makes the claude CLI the model of the chat and the minds (and registers its rung); by default no model is chosen and the person picks one the local Ollama lists

router_on.why: whether the router exists (the autoselect lanes are offered)

cloud_models.why: the router's cloud candidates, as rows

started.why: the seat says it has started (Boot:seat.started = now): the packs build their nodes in setters on it (fields_live.boot_started)

chat_claude_bin.why: the claude CLI's path for the bare chat's turn (packs/chat_turn.c1f); told by `cliffvm run ... --fact chat_claude_bin=<path>`; no default: unset = the message is answered with an error and nothing runs

chat_max_turns.why: the bare chat's ceiling: the CLI's --max-turns for one answer (chat_turn.c1f; default 2048 in the pack, a threshold the operator approves); told by `--fact chat_max_turns=<n>`

request_keep_s.why: ACCEPTED AND IGNORED since the garbage collection of virtual entities (docs/cliffvm.md): a door request is collected by the engine as soon as nothing holds it, nothing is kept for a while; the fact stays so a launch line that passes it does not break

memory_budget_mb.why: the memory budget of the seat in MB (cliffvm:src/host.rs `evict_under_pressure`; default: 10% of the machine's memory, or a container's lower limit; `MemoryConfig::with_defaults`): the VM itself evicts the coldest loaded stored entities when the process is over the lines; unset = no pressure and nothing is evicted; told by `--fact memory_budget_mb=<n>`

unload_soft.why: the soft line as a fraction of memory_budget_mb (no default): the VM starts to evict from this fraction; unset = there is no soft line (below the hard line is fine); told by `--fact unload_soft=<f>`

unload_hard.why: the hard line as a fraction of memory_budget_mb (default 0.9): the VM evicts from this fraction; unset = the default; told by `--fact unload_hard=<f>`

unload_batch.why: how many of the coldest entities one eviction pass takes out of the engine (cliffvm:src/host.rs; default 200): unset = the default; a pass runs at the end of every drain while the process is over a line; told by `--fact unload_batch=<n>`

command_timeout_s.why: the time limit in seconds of a Command run that states no `timeout_s` (cliffvm:src/drivers.rs; default 120, the operator-delegated sensible default 2026-11-13): past it the process group gets SIGTERM, 2 s later SIGKILL, and the receipt is status timeout; told by `--fact command_timeout_s=<n>`

chat_turn_timeout_s.why: the time limit in seconds of one chat turn's `claude` run (chat_turn.c1f; default 21600 = 6 h in the pack, a threshold flagged for the operator): the turn is exempt from `command_timeout_s`; told by `--fact chat_turn_timeout_s=<n>`

sql_sources.why: second SQLite files to open as entities (membrane/packs/sql.c1f, cliffvm:src/sqldrv.rs): a LIST of {name, path, mode} (mode ro, the default, opens the file read-only and immutable; rw may write); each entry SEEDS `SqlSource:<name>` as if it were written by hand, and a source that already has a path is left alone; the seat's own store is refused; told by `--fact sql_sources='[{"name": "lex", "path": "/data/words.sqlite"}]'`

legacy_path.why: the earlier (Python, 0.7.x) seat's store, for the automatic history cutover (membrane/packs/legacy_cutover.c1f; #1143): a file (its field.sqlite3), or a folder that holds it (its `.membrane` folder, its `field.sqlite` folder, or the folder of field.sqlite3). Told, it is the ONLY place looked at (a path that holds no store is an error shown as text, never a fallback); unset, the seat looks in `<seat_data_dir>`, `<seat_data_dir>/.membrane`, `<seat_cwd>/.membrane`, `<seat_home>/membrane/.membrane` and `/config/membrane/.membrane` (each `field.sqlite/field.sqlite3`), the first that has a store wins, and when none has one nothing happens; told by `--fact legacy_path=<path>` (the launcher's `--legacy <path>`)

env_allow.why: names of environment variables that carry their VALUE on `Environment:host` besides the default list (HOME, USER, LANG, XDG_DATA_HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, TMPDIR, CLAUDE_BIN, MEMBRANE_DATA_DIR; cliffvm:src/host.rs `boot_environment`, membrane/packs/environment.c1f); a JSON list or text with commas; a name with KEY, TOKEN, SECRET, PASSWORD, PASSWD or CREDENTIAL in it is refused (it reads `set`, never its value) and the start says so; told by `--fact env_allow=FOO_BAR`

legacy_batch.why: the automatic history cutover's page (membrane/packs/legacy_cutover.c1f; #1143): how many old user rows one query reads, and so how many questions one background step imports and then leaves out of memory; default 5 (measured on the real store: 20 stalled the seat up to 3.5 s a page, 5 up to 0.9 s; a number flagged for the operator); told by `--fact legacy_batch=<n>`

embed_model.why: the embedding model that makes the vector of each sentence (membrane/packs/embed.c1f; asked of the model server at `seat_backend`, `POST /api/embed`); default mxbai-embed-large (operator-approved 2026-11-14; set in launcher.c1f); told by `--fact embed_model=<name>`

effect_workers.why: the cap on Command / File / Fetch / SqlQuery effects running at once (cliffvm:src/store.rs `effect_limited`; default 4, operator-approved 2026-11-13): an effect past the cap waits for a slot; a held door request, an open stream and `Command.stop` are no workers; told by `--fact effect_workers=<n>`

eval_stats.why: the eval accounting (cliffvm:src/stats.rs): default ON; `--fact eval_stats=false` turns it off (no counting, no `Stats:eval` entity). On, `Stats:eval` holds the top 20 getters/setters by self time of the last window and of the lifetime

eval_stats_window_s.why: the seconds between two publications of `Stats:eval` (default 10, a threshold flagged for the operator); told by `--fact eval_stats_window_s=<s>`

host_names.why: the Host names (besides localhost, 127.0.0.1 and [::1]) for which a loopback request is given the page's admin cookie (door_auth.c1f, the DNS-rebinding check); a JSON list or comma text, no default list; told by `--fact host_names=<a,b>`

admin_token_file.why: where `cliffvm run` wrote the admin's token (<seat_data_dir>/admin.token, mode 0600) when the seat has a door secret; chat_turn.c1f adds the Authorization header and the run's env_from only when it is set; absent on the barest seat

admin_token_ttl_s.why: how long the admin token minted at every boot lives, in seconds (cliffvm:src/admin.rs); default 2592000 (30 days), a threshold flagged for the operator; told by `--fact admin_token_ttl_s=<n>`

quota_probe_s.why: the quota probe interval the page shows, seconds (released PROBE_S 600); a `--fact` setting, default 600

field_tau_s.why: the field current's fade `tau_s` / options `current_tau_s`, seconds (released 180.0); a `--fact` setting, default 180.0

self_cpu_share_default.why: the `self_cpu_share` option's default (released 0.5); a `--fact` setting, default 0.5

code_runs_keep_default.why: the `code_runs_keep` option's default (released 30); a `--fact` setting, default 30

chat_page_size.why: the chat view's first load and each "Load older turns": how many turns the history route is asked for (default 20, the legacy chat.js PAGE)

chat_poll_size.why: the chat view's polls: how many of the newest turns are read again (default 10, the legacy POLL)

chat_list_poll_ms.why: the chat view's poll period once every turn is finished, ms after the last answer (default 3000, the legacy LIST_MS)

chat_active_poll_ms.why: the chat view's poll period while a turn is not finished, ms; also the period the page ticks the clock (default 700, the legacy ACTIVE_MS)

chat_stick_px.why: the chat view: the log counts as "at the bottom" within this many px (default 80, the legacy stick-to-bottom distance; kept as state, the page has no scroll write yet)

chat_tool_chars.why: the chat view: a tool's input is shown cut to this many characters, with an ellipsis (default 90, the legacy short())
